## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The change to the default timeout and its test are correct; the remaining fix is the README, which still says requests time out after 30 seconds.

## Changes
This pull request raises `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT` in `app/cli.py` from 30 to 60 and changes `test_defaults` to expect 60. It also adds a one-line `review.txt` at the repository root.

## Important
- app/cli.py:3 — comments — Update README default timeout to 60 seconds — With no `--timeout`, requests now wait 60 seconds, but `README.md:3` still says "Requests time out after 30 seconds unless you pass `--timeout SECONDS`." — Users and operators who rely on the README will expect requests to fail after 30 seconds, not 60. — Fix: Change `README.md:3` to say 60 seconds.
